Bail Bond Information for Yolo County

After booking into Yolo County jail, a judge typically sets bail at arraignment (often within 24–72 hours). Families often work with a licensed bail bondsman. A common commercial bond fee is about 10% of the bail amount (non-refundable). Example: $10,000 bail → roughly $1,000 premium, subject to local rules.

If the person cannot afford bail, they may request a reduction hearing or public defender.

For hearing schedules, contact the Yolo County court.

Visitation Rules at Yolo County Jail

Policies vary. Before visiting Monroe Detention Center, confirm:

  • Approved ID: Government-issued photo ID
  • Hours: Call Yolo County Sheriff's Office for the current schedule
  • Dress code: Facilities restrict clothing that resembles uniforms
  • Video visits: Many jails offer remote options — ask when you call
  • Children: Minors usually need an accompanying adult

What to Expect After Arrest in Yolo County

Typical steps after arrest in Yolo County:

  1. Booking — fingerprints, photo, property inventory
  2. Medical screening — before general population housing
  3. Classification — housing based on charges and history
  4. Arraignment — first court appearance; bail often set here
  5. Transfer — serious cases may move to a state facility

Frequently Asked Questions — Yolo County Inmate Lookup

How do I find out if someone is in Yolo County jail?

Start with the official Yolo County inmate roster. You can also call Yolo County Sheriff's Office at (530) 668-5245. Online records often lag booking by a few hours.

What is the phone number for Monroe Detention Center?

Contact Yolo County Sheriff's Office at (530) 668-5245. Facility address on file: 2420 E Gibson Rd, Woodland, CA 95776.

How long does booking take in Yolo County?

Booking commonly takes 2–8 hours depending on volume at Monroe Detention Center. Weekends and holidays can delay when a name appears in any published system. If urgent, call the facility directly rather than waiting on a website refresh.

Can I visit an inmate at Yolo County jail?

Usually yes if the person is eligible and the facility is accepting visits. The main facility listed is Monroe Detention Center at 2420 E Gibson Rd, Woodland, CA 95776. Bring government photo ID and confirm hours and dress code with Yolo County Sheriff's Office before you go. Video visitation may be offered.

What if the person is not listed in the county system?

They may have been released, transferred, or booked under a different name spelling. Check California Department of Corrections and the Federal BOP locator for federal custody. Then call Yolo County Sheriff's Office to confirm.

How do I send money to someone at Monroe Detention Center?

Ask Monroe Detention Center which commissary vendor they use (often JPay, Securus, or Access Corrections) when you call (530) 668-5245. Limits and fees vary by facility — confirm before sending money.
